items.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
items.summary: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
items.summary: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
items.summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
items.summary: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.
items.author: Julie Bort

items.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
items.summary: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
items.author: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
items.summary: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.summary: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
items.summary: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

items.title: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
items.summary: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.
items.author: Kate Park

items.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
items.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
items.author: Julie Bort

items.title: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
items.summary: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.
